Class AlgoReplayBooking

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoReplayBooking
All Implemented Interfaces:
AlgoReplayAccounts.SettlementFunds
@Service public class AlgoReplayBooking extends Object implements AlgoReplayAccounts.SettlementFunds
Turns one replayed order into a portfolio transaction: fill date and price, the account that pays, the money that has to be brought together when no single account can, and the write to the ordinary ledger.

AlgoReplayAccounts decides where an order lives. This class decides how much of it can actually be booked and writes the fill, using the same overdraft and FX conventions as the transaction write path so a choice made here is not refused there.

    • availableFor

      public double availableFor(Cashaccount cashaccount, LocalDate date, String currency)
      What a cash account can spend on a day, read exactly the way the transaction write path reads it, so an account chosen here is not refused there for a reason the choice did not consider. An account that may be overdrawn - borrowingRate is set - has no limit at all.

      The answer is expressed in the currency of the instrument rather than in the one of the account, converted at the rate the fill itself would carry, because that is the rate the order is booked at and because the accounts of an environment are only comparable with one another that way. Where that rate does not exist the account answers that it can settle nothing: the order would be refused there with REPLAY_FX_UNAVAILABLE, so any other account is the better answer, and where there is none the choice hands the order back to it and the refusal is reported.

      Specified by:
      availableFor in interface AlgoReplayAccounts.SettlementFunds
      Parameters:
      cashaccount - the account in question
      date - the settlement day
      currency - the currency of the instrument
      Returns:
      the spendable amount in the currency of the instrument, infinite where the account may be overdrawn and negative infinite where it has no rate to settle that currency with on that day

    • transferable

      public double transferable(Cashaccount from, Cashaccount to, LocalDate date)
      What one account could hand to another one, in the currency of the receiving account. The rate is the one of the transfer direction, not of the order, and only that direction of the pair may exist - which is why an account that cannot be priced towards the target answers that it can pass nothing rather than being asked to try.
      Specified by:
      transferable in interface AlgoReplayAccounts.SettlementFunds
      Parameters:
      from - the account the money would leave
      to - the account it would arrive on
      date - the day of the transfer
      Returns:
      the amount in the currency of to, or negative infinity when the transfer cannot be priced
